# Local-model workloads beyond memory and RAG: cross-family convergence (2026-09-24)

## Method

- One packet (`local-uses-packet.md`) went to two blind lanes. Neither lane saw the other lane's
  output or the catalogs.
  - Claude lane: Opus 5.5, web research (`local-uses-claude.md`).
  - Codex lane: GPT-6 Astra, high effort, web search, user config and hooks disabled
    (`local-uses-codex.md`).
- One disagreement went to a blind adjudicator, GPT-6 Sol at high effort, which checked the cited
  sources itself. It judged the two returns once in each presentation order
  (`adjudication/`).
- Evidence grades: I independent, A academic, S maker, C competitor, P popularity.

## Converged (both lanes, independently)

| Workload | Default | Challenger | Strongest evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Catalyst tagging and extraction from 8-Ks and releases (ex-post labels, never live signals) | Qwen3.8-27B with a JSON schema (installed) | GLiNER2 (gliner2.5-base-v1) as a CPU student | S: Massive (arXiv 2607.08346), 119 event types over 292,984 8-Ks; A: GLiNER2 (EMNLP 2025). Local accuracy unknown. | Trial: 1,000 stratified 8-Ks plus 300 hand-checked, macro-F1 against frontier labels |
| Earnings-call transcription | Cohere Transcribe 03-2026 (2B, mlx-audio) | Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v3 through FluidAudio on CoreML | I: Open ASR long-form leaderboard, Earnings-21/22 WER 8.7/12.66 (Cohere) vs 9.96/14.58 (Parakeet) vs 9.84/13.1 (Whisper v3 turbo); M (S): Parakeet 155–207× real time on M4 Pro | Trial: full Earnings-21/22 calls, WER, entity WER, real-time factor |
| Image-only exhibits and scans | TeleOCR (1.2B) | PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 (0.9B, official MLX-VLM path) | I: OmniDocBench v1.6, 96.91 vs 96.34; A: EDGAR-OCR, 300 SEC tables | Trial, narrow: XBRL and HTML already cover most filings |
| Time-series foundation models for volatility and volume features | Chronos-2 (120M) | TTM r2.1 (~1M, CPU) | A: Brini 2026, only TTM beats Log-HAR on realized volatility; S: fev-bench | Trial, low priority; never for returns (A: Rahimikia 2025, negative out-of-sample R²) |
| Not local | Primary agent loop, authoritative judging, strategy selection | — | I: Artificial Analysis 34 (Qwen3.8-27B) vs 56–58 (Opus 5.5) and 52–53 (GPT-6 Astra) | Skip |

## Adjudicated

| Question | Claude lane | Codex lane | Adjudication (both orders) | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tabular foundation models (TabICLv2, TabPFN-3.5) for +200% mover prediction | Skip | Trial | Skip, the same in both presentation orders. Decisive: BeyondArena (A, arXiv 2606.30410), and TabPFN-3.5's own report, which says tuned MLPs still lead its temporal and large subsets | Skip until a walk-forward comparison beats CatBoost |

## Single-lane leads (not converged; discovery only)

| Workload | Lane | Candidate | Evidence | Next step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Point-in-time text features for backtests: dated weights as the lookahead-bias control | Claude | PIT-4B-FT; ChronoGPT/ChronoBERT | A: Gao et al. 2026, Zhang & Stadie 2026 (lookahead leakage); A/S: Kelly et al. 2026 | Highest north-star value. Trial on EdgarTools 8-Ks 2015–2024, out-of-sample rank-IC against Loughran-McDonald tone |
| Prompt-injection screening of tool output in hooks | Claude | PIGuard (184M); Prompt Guard 2 (86M) | A: PIArena (ACL 2026), PIDS-Bench (2026) | Trial as flag-only, never a security boundary |
| Failure-log triage | Codex | Qwen3.8-27B | S only | Trial, asynchronous, raw logs retained |
| Editor next-edit suggestions | Codex | Sweep next-edit v2-7B | Throughput only | Only if editing by hand is frequent |

## Limits

- No workload above was executed on this Mac. Every throughput figure is measured elsewhere or
  estimated.
- Both lanes may share training-era blind spots.
- The adjudicator is from the same family as the Codex lane; the order swap mitigates this but
  does not remove it.
